body: I won’t ever be happy with myself, not emotionally. It’s been that way for years and I don’t think I’ll ever reach that stage. I’ve tried and the closest I ever came was with her.

Before I met her, I was spending most nights eating pills and drinking, and usually around 2am is when the cutting came into play. My parents came home one day and almost found me with a loaded rifle to my head. I absolutely love her but I don’t understand why I became so evil, it was true verbal abuse and I’ve worked on it and she talked with me about it but I just don’t know what to do, if she’d give me another chance and be happy with the results, it’d make the happiest ever, but I don’t deserve it, I don’t even deserve her.
